title: Introduce cost-cascade orchestrator and tenant quant-tiering tooling
author: Maya Chen
summary_commits: initial scaffold for cost-cascade orchestrator and CLI glue
implement tier selection and quant-profile selector logic
add telemetry, unit tests and e2e harness
docs: RFC and operator upgrade notes
fix: handle tenant overrides during rollout
description: Motivation: tenants with mixed traffic patterns need safer automated defaults that trade unit economics against latency and quality. Current defaults were static and produced either high cost for low-value queries or risky aggressive quantization that regressed quality for some tenants. This PR introduces a 'cost-cascade' orchestrator that sequences conservative-to-aggressive defaults per-tenant and a companion quant-tiering tool to express and evaluate quant profiles by workload characteristics. Summary of changes: 1) runtime: new pkg/econ/cascade.go implements the orchestrator state machine that evaluates traffic signals (p50/p95 latency, coldstart ratio, token distribution) and advances/downgrades tenant tiers with rate-limited transitions; 2) quant profiles: pkg/econ/quant_tiers.go adds a declarative, ordered set of quant tiers and compatibility checks against model variants; 3) control plane: cmd/costctl adds CLI to simulate cascades and dry-run tenant rollouts and to export/import presets; 4) web console: CostAdvisor component and useTenantProfiles hook surface recommended default tier and preview of cost/latency tradeoffs; 5) operator & helm: values-prefill.yaml and econ-configmap templates expose tenant sampling and transition windows; 6) telemetry/tests: metrics_econ.go adds cascade state metrics and tests/e2e/cost_cascade_test.go covers transition correctness under synthetic workloads; 7) docs: docs/rfc/cost-cascade.md and upgrade notes explain semantics and rollback guidance. Commits: initial scaffold and unit tests, iterative fixes for race conditions in transition timer logic, add e2e workload harness and document rollout strategy. Files changed (high level): small focused changes to runtime/econ, CLI, web UI, helm charts, docs and tests. Benchmarks & validation: synthetic benchmark run with bench_cascade_runner.sh across three tenant profiles shows median cost per 1k requests reduced 12% for latency-tolerant workloads and kept p95 latency within SLO for customer-like traces; quality regressions tested against representative prompt set and quant-tier guardrails prevented >0.5% accuracy drop relative to baseline in our sample. Rollout plan: staged canary via Dedicated rollout policy for 5% tenants for 48 hours, telemetry checks for quality, cost, and errors; automatic rollback on quality-signal or p95 breach. Backwards compatibility & safety: default behavior is opt-in per-tenant; operator will not change existing tenant defaults unless explicitly enabled. Security/Audit: operator changes are config-only and recorded in audit logs; CLI requires existing RBAC. Docs & migration: new RFC and operator upgrade notes with migration steps and recommended presets for common workloads. Related work: complements ENG-2380 (tenant warmstart sampling) and builds on ENG-2410 which provided the quant-profile schema. Known limitations: current rollout uses simple exponential backoff for retries and does not yet account for cross-tenant interference in multi-tenant GPU pools; follow-up tickets recommended.
review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Nice shape. Two asks: (1) add a circuit-breaker metric so we can alert on a runaway cascade; (2) please add a small integration test that simulates a tenant that flips between latency-sensitive and cost-sensitive patterns.
Author (Maya Chen): Added metrics_econ.go with cascade_circuit_breaker_count and extended e2e to include a flip-pattern scenario; addressed race in transition timer mentioned in comments.
Priya Desai: Please ensure quant tier compatibility check prevents selecting model variants that lack KV-cache support. Also asked for a short note in operator upgrade notes.
Author (Maya Chen): Added compatibility check and a paragraph in docs/operator/upgrade-notes.md. Tests added to validate fallback to nearest compatible variant.
Noah Kaplan (approval): Verified benchmarks and unit tests. Approving for merge pending CI green.

release_notes: Introduce cost-cascade orchestrator (opt-in tenant feature) and quant-tiering tooling. Adds CLI to dry-run rollouts and new telemetry metrics. Default not applied to existing tenants; operator upgrade notes included.
notes_for_ops: Operator: to enable globally set helm value econ.enableCascade=true and configure sampling windows. Start with sample_rate 0.05 and transition_window 48h. Watch cascade_circuit_breaker_count and tenant_prefill_mismatch_rate metrics.
